class.name: joint_hardware/JointHardware
class.description: Transport-neutral ros2_control hardware interface for peripheral joint motors. Set the simulate hardware parameter to true only for the generic non-lift plugin.

class.name: joint_hardware/LiftHardware
class.description: EtherCAT CiA 402 CSV lift hardware. Use ethercat_backend=mock for offline tests, or ethercat_backend=etherlab when the optional IgH/EtherLab master is installed and the slave identity/PDO/Distributed Clock configuration has been confirmed.

class.name: joint_hardware/WaistHardware
class.description: USB-FDCAN CANopen/vendor-frame ros2_control hardware interface for joint_qugan.
